name: Quốc hội Việt Nam
notes: 16th National Assembly (Khóa XVI, 2026-2031), elected 15 March 2026; the National Election Council announced the result on 21 March 2026. 500 deputies: 18 non-Party (3.6%) and, by subtraction, 482 Party members. The 18 are shown as Independent. Vietnam is a one-party state with no other parties in the Assembly. No member is named here.
